atom: Native filename encoding of the FS136 verification process
pattern: Use an installed UTF-8 native locale for existing Unicode-path fixtures; do not alter the product or weaken filename assertions.
trigger: The ASCII C locale caused localNamesPreserveUnicodePercentAndSpaces to fail in Path.resolve before product execution. The other 135 tests passed.
root_cause: sun.jnu.encoding and native.encoding were ANSI_X3.4-1968 under C and UTF-8 under C.UTF-8, while file.encoding alone was UTF-8 in both.
change: Change only the verification environment LC_ALL from C to C.UTF-8.
refusal: Replay refuses source/dependency drift and existing output paths. The historical failure remains unchanged.
scope: Verification harness environment; no product recipe correction, public API change, whole-JDK acceptance, or permission grant.
